parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give an account of what happened when Jesus was born in Bethlehem.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain Christian beliefs about the significance of one group that visited the infant Jesus.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The teachings in the story of Christmas should be shared with everyone.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe Christian beliefs about the origin and authority of the Ten Commandments.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain how obeying two of the Ten Commandments might affect the behaviour of a
Christian.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Believers need guidance to help them to understand how to obey the Ten Commandments.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the different types of charitable acts that Christians might carry out through their local
church.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Christians believe that missionary work is important.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘A person does not have to be a member of a church to be a good Christian.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer. 
Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how Muhammad (pbuh) received help during the hijrah.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Muhammad (pbuh) was persecuted so severely in Makkah.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘The behaviour of Muhammad (pbuh) during the difficult times in Makkah is a perfect lesson
for Muslims today.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the Muslim belief in risalah (Prophets) and Angels.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the importance to Muslims of the belief in Tawhid (unity of God).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Children should be taught to follow their religion at an early age.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe how the religious duties of zakah and sadaqah (voluntary contributions) are carried
out.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the importance to Muslims of supporting the work of Muslim aid organisations.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘All Muslims are equally important in the sight of God.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer. 
Section C – Judaism
If you have chosen this section answer all of the parts in two of the questions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the Mishnah (oral law) and its use as a source of authority.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the purpose of the Talmud (commentary).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Studying the Jewish scriptures is the best way for Jews to understand God.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the work of an international Jewish relief aid agency.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the challenges Jews might face when trying to follow the food laws.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Kind actions are the best way to help people in need.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the religious responsibilities of a woman in a traditional Jewish family.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why the home environment is important in caring for the family in Judaism.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Differences of religion should not cause conflict in a marriage.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Judaism in your answer.
